prayerExcerpt.en-US: She could do more, because she loved more.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Pôde mais aquela que mais amou.

meta.face: A woman of about forty with a soft, round, fair face, grey-blue eyes, gently arched light-brown brows, rosy cheeks and a warm, quiet smile; her gaze is lifted a little upward.
meta.basis: No portrait or description survives; Gregory's Dialogues give only her love, her prayer and the dove. The face is an artistic choice that keeps her apart from the other nuns of this batch: younger, round-faced and smiling.
meta.excerpt: Gregory the Great, Dialogues II.33: 'illa plus potuit, quae amplius amavit' (our rendering of the Latin in both languages)
